main_text.head: Tertium τροπισμα.
main_text.p: SVB quocunq; Parallelo inter æquinoctialem & tropicum Cancri habitantibus, quouis anno Sol bis fit uerticalis. Paralleli enim quos puncta uerticalia ibidem describunt, Ecipticam in duobus punctis secant. Quare umbras illi meridianas nullas habent sole puncta intersectionum occupante. Rursus ad Austrum procidunt eædem, cum segmentum eclipticæ minus seu boreale, quod puncta illa auellunt, permeat. Contra in boream protenduntur cum alterum segmentum maius transcurrit. Sed sub Tropico æstiuo uersantibus Sol semel tantum fit uerticalis, quod Parallelus ille Eclipti-cam in uno tantum puncto contingit. Vmbram igitur

page.notes: The diagrams are not transcribed as text. Red manuscript marks in the margins are excluded. Spelling kept as printed: "Ecipticam" and "Eclipti-" as printed; the first line of the paragraph is set in large type; the running line "cam in uno tantum" is the continuation of the text across the figure.
